steps.response:
Current screenshot and tree reflection:
- The bookmarks bar is now visible under the address bar (you can see the Apps grid icon).
- To create a new folder, we need to right-click on the empty area of the bookmarks bar and select “Add folder…” from the context menu.

```python
import pyautogui, time
# Right-click on an empty spot of the bookmarks bar
pyautogui.click(200, 160, button='right')
time.sleep(0.5)
# Click “Add folder…” in the context menu
pyautogui.click(200, 200)
```
